name: Trip sheet takes focus, makes the page inert, and gives it back

planSteps.description: Without clicking any other link first, click the add trip button (data-testid=trip-add)
The trip sheet dialog (data-testid=trip-sheet) is open and the keyboard focus is in its entry date field (data-testid=trip-entry)

Check the DOM attributes (not the appearance): document.getElementById('calculator').closest('[inert]') is an element (the page section wrapping the calculator carries the inert attribute), and document.querySelector('[data-testid=trip-sheet]').closest('[inert]') is null
The trip sheet is closed; in the DOM, document.querySelectorAll('[inert]').length is 0; and document.activeElement is the add trip button (its data-testid is trip-add)
